summary.title: FinPay Core Services Threat Model
summary.description: Architectural threat model and STRIDE assessment for FinPay Core Services covering public DMZ, EKS service mesh, and isolated data persistence tiers.

diagrams.title: FinPay Core DFD Level 1
diagrams.placeholder: Data flow diagram for FinPay hybrid cloud microservices

cells.name: External Client
cells.description: Public web and mobile users accessing the payment gateway.

cells.name: TB-01: Public Perimeter (DMZ)
cells.description: Perimeter boundary between the public internet and AWS edge services.

threats.title: Forged JWT via Key Confusion / None Alg
threats.description: Attacker crafts unsigned tokens or exploits symmetric/asymmetric key confusion to spoof authenticated users.
threats.mitigation: Enforce strict RS256 algorithm whitelisting and dynamic JWKS validation against Entra ID endpoints.

threats.title: Resource Exhaustion via Unthrottled Endpoints
threats.description: Flooding endpoints with unindexed search queries causes connection pool starvation across internal components.
threats.mitigation: Deploy AWS WAF token-bucket rate-limiting rules and API Gateway per-client usage plans.

cells.name: TB-02: Kubernetes Ingress / Service Mesh
cells.description: Boundary separating the edge reverse proxy from internal private EKS pods.

cells.name: Customer-Service Pod
cells.description: EKS microservice managing user metadata and account profiles.

threats.title: Unsigned Financial Audit Trails
threats.description: Transactional records lack cryptographic nonces or write-once retention, allowing malicious alteration.
threats.mitigation: Stream immutable audit logs directly to Amazon S3 Object Lock with WORM compliance enabled.

threats.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
threats.description: Manipulating account_id headers in payment capture payloads allows unauthorized balance deductions.
threats.mitigation: Implement Open Policy Agent (OPA) fine-grained authorization comparing JWT subject claim against target account IDs.

cells.name: TB-03: Isolated Database Subnet
cells.description: Restricted subnet hosting persistent relational data stores.

threats.title: PII Exfiltration via Over-Privileged Service Account
threats.description: Direct read queries from compromised pod credentials leak unencrypted cardholder data and tax identifiers.
threats.mitigation: Enforce AWS KMS column-level envelope encryption and switch to IAM ephemeral database authentication tokens.

cells.name: HTTPS (TLS 1.3)
cells.description: External user requests crossing the public perimeter.

cells.name: Reverse Proxy Dispatch
cells.description: Forwarded API requests entering the private compute cluster.

threats.title: Pod-to-Pod Lateral Packet Tampering
threats.description: Unencrypted inter-service traffic allows compromised neighbor pods to sniff and modify payment parameters.
threats.mitigation: Implement Istio/Cilium mutual TLS (mTLS) with SPIFFE workload identity and explicit Layer 7 network policies.

cells.name: SQL Persistence Queries
cells.description: Database queries crossing into the database subnet.

cells.name: Immutable Audit Streaming
cells.description: Streaming transaction logs to tamper-proof cloud storage.
